explanation: Bucha was occupied because it lies on the road from Belarus to Kyiv, which is the axis of the attempt to take the capital in the first days of the invasion, and the killings were done during that occupation and found when the column withdrew at the end of March. The claim is about the occasion and nothing more: what a Russian army was doing in a commuter town thirty kilometres from Kyiv is answered entirely by the plan of 24 February. Whether the killings were ordered, tolerated or done by units out of control is a question of command responsibility that this edge does not decide.
